html:
Ho Chi Minh City to Mui Ne One Day Tour offers travelers a chance to explore some of the most beautiful natural landscapes in southern Vietnam within a single day. This tour is ideal for visitors who enjoy nature, photography, and light adventure activities.

During the journey, you will discover white and red sand dunes, a peaceful lake in the middle of the desert, a unique stream flowing through colorful sand formations, and the authentic daily life of local fishermen. The tour combines scenic views, cultural experiences, and leisure time, making it a memorable getaway from the city.

ITINERARY

07:00 – 07:30

Pick up at the airport or hotel in Ho Chi Minh City by private car.

11:00 – 13:30

Arrive in Mui Ne and visit Bau Trang.

Bau Trang, A Mystical Lake among White Sand Dunes

Bau Trang is one of the most beautiful natural attractions in Mui Ne. The lake is famous for its clear turquoise water surrounded by vast white sand dunes, creating a peaceful and impressive landscape.

Visitors can enjoy the fresh air, admire panoramic views, and take memorable photographs. Optional activities such as boat rides on the lake are available. The contrast between the blue water and white sand makes Bau Trang an ideal destination for photography lovers.

13:00

Have lunch at a local restaurant.

14:30

Visit Suoi Tien.

Suoi Tien, A Turquoise Stream in the Sand Dunes

Suoi Tien is a unique natural site where a shallow stream flows through red sand dunes. The bright turquoise water contrasts beautifully with the warm red sand, creating a rare and striking landscape.

Walking along the stream allows visitors to enjoy the natural scenery and observe fascinating rock formations shaped by wind and water. The area offers a calm and visually impressive experience.

16:00

Visit Mui Ne Fishing Village

Stop at the fishing village to take photos and observe the daily life of local fishermen. This area provides insight into the traditional coastal lifestyle of Mui Ne.

16:30

Visit the Red Sand Dunes and watch the sunset.

Red Sand Dunes, A Land of Vibrant Colors

The Red Sand Dunes are one of the most famous attractions in Mui Ne. The dunes are known for their warm red and orange tones, which become especially beautiful during sunset.

Visitors can walk on the dunes, enjoy the scenery, and take photos. Optional sand sliding activities are available at personal expense.

17:00

Depart Mui Ne and return to Ho Chi Minh City.

20:00 – 20:30

Arrive back at the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City.

TOUR INCLUSIONS

Private car pickup and drop off

English speaking tour guide

Local lunch

Entrance tickets to attractions

TOUR EXCLUSIONS

Jeep service at sand dunes

Value added tax

Personal expenses
